data.title: 芙兰达 · 街头露天甜品桌的奶油沾鼻尖
data.description: 学园都市繁华商业街的遮阳伞下，芙兰达鼻尖沾了一点草莓可丽饼奶油。当你失笑伸手替她擦拭并抿进口中时，金发少女瞬间整张脸涨红，慌乱地挥舞小拳头假装生气。
data.location: sunny outdoor pedestrian cafe under large white umbrella
data.action: sitting at cafe table with cream on her nose, partner wipes it away, blushing furiously with wide blue eyes and a cute flustered pout
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunlit afternoon dappling through parasol
data.mood: adorable flustered tsundere reaction, lively outdoor date, irresistible teasing chemistry
data.promptProse: At a sunny cafe table, blonde Frenda Seivelun blushes furiously with wide blue eyes as partner wipes sweet cream from her nose.
